text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday, as reported by the official news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- By inaugurating the Maghreb-Europe gas pipeline Algeria gets fresh openings in market for gas exports.
- Algeria expects $6 billion receipts from operations through gas pipeline linking Maghreb to Europe.
- Thirty prominent public figures publish manifesto for peace.
- Gas pipeline to balance relations between the two sides of the Mediterranean.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia says in meeting that Nov 28 referendum to review Algerian constitution will ensure stability and national unity.
- President Liamine Zeroual determined to normalise situation in Algeria despite "tempests".
- Saharans appreciate Morocco's signs of openness over referendum in Western Sahara.
